svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Mint Tilt $0 logo, v5
svg.desc: The matched two-point tag rotates eight degrees as one form, preserving equal lobe dimensions and spacing. A soft mint body carries a smaller complementary-green dollar beside a larger deep-green zero. Paired with the exact Free-Stuff-Near-You name in deep green. Original, unadopted concept with editable text and transparent surroundings.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif
